result.summary: UAT v7: EO-001 PARTIAL/MINOR (saga completed — tenant ACTIVE in DB, swiftroute realm + alice.bauer in KC — but Playwright test timed out before result screen was observed; saga took ~130s vs 120s test timeout). EO-002 PASS (progress spinner visible in step 03). EO-003 PASS (Alice Bauer successfully logged into swiftroute Keycloak account page — screenshot confirmed). EO-004 FAIL BLOCKER: onboarding saga creates bpm-platform-api Keycloak client without audience protocol mapper. Alice JWT has aud='account' instead of aud='bpm-platform-api'. Backend rejects with HTTP 401 invalid token audience. Screen shows 'Redirecting to login...' loop — Alice cannot reach workspace. New issue vs v6: ISS-0073 fix confirmed working (redirect goes to swiftroute KC realm), but audience check is the new blocker.

issues.description: The SwiftRoute workspace login is blocked. The onboarding saga creates the bpm-platform-api Keycloak client in the tenant realm without an audience protocol mapper. Alice's JWT has aud='account' instead of aud='bpm-platform-api'. Backend returns HTTP 401 invalid token audience. Alice sees 'Redirecting to login...' in a loop and cannot access her workspace.

Onboarding pipeline Playwright test timeout (120s) is shorter than saga execution time (~130s). test.setTimeout should be increased to >=200s to allow saga to complete and result screen to be observed.

result.next_action: Route ISS-UAT-V7-001 to BACKEND-DEV via WF-03: add audience protocol mapper to onboarding saga's bpm-platform-api client creation. Re-run WF-05 v8 after fix. ISS-UAT-V7-002 route to TEST-DESIGNER.
